PART III – LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 5

AS the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation hereby declare that the land described below is required for a public purpose and will be acquired under the provisions of Sub-section (1) of Section 5 of the Land Acquisition Act.

The boundaries to the Land portions with undermentioned names and extents depicted in the Surveyor General's advance tracing bearing No.R/GDK/2022/273 dated 24.07.2023 situated in the Village called Bibilegama (f.v.p.742) in the Grama Niladhari Division of No.223/C, Bibilegama West in Atakalan Korale Minor Division, in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Godakawela, in Ratnapura District, Sabaragamuwa Province.

01. Lot ''A'' - Name of land :- Palamkotta Watta-extent: about 47.3211 HectaresNorth: Lot No. 708; East: Lot No. 708, 707 and Lot ''A'' in Tracing No. R/GDK/2022/274; South: Lot No. 708, 707 and Lot ''A'' in Tracing No. R/GDK/2022/272 FVP 926 Mawussakanda, Lot Nos. 363 and 362; West: FVP 926 Mawussakanda, Lot Nos. 363,362 and 708.
K. D. LAL KANTHA, Minister of Agriculture, Livestock Land and Irrigation.
My Ref. No.: 4-2/23/2021/FR/217.Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation,“Mihikatha Medura”, Rajamalwatta Road,Battaramulla,04th December 2024.
